string._help_open: open_races / open_factions / open_keywords: NPCs in these groups are forward even as strangers, but reserved while on duty. Races by name or form, factions by form, keywords by EditorID or form. A form is "0x<FormID in its plugin>|<plugin file>". Example: open_races ["Succubus"], open_factions ["0x000D62|SomeCourtesanMod.esp"], open_keywords ["SomeCourtesanKeyword"].
string._help_duty: duty_factions: members are on duty (always reserved) unless they travel with the player. Guards count without being listed.
